PROMOTION BLOCKED, and not by anything in this TU: the class carries a COINED name. The cartridge's RTTI spells it daSpd_c (_ZTS7daSpd_c at ov071:0x02122bf0, _ZTI7daSpd_c at 0x02122bfc); the tree spells the class Scuttlebug, so the key function emits _ZTS10Scuttlebug (0xd bytes, "10Scuttlebug\0") and _ZTI10Scuttlebug, and no symbols.txt in the tree names either. Both dispositions are closed, measured: deadstrip-data is refused with "has no configured ROM home; a homeless object is a plain deadstrip", and plain deadstrip is refused with "is an RTTI/vtable record banked as a plain deadstrip, which is never compared against the cartridge ... rename it to the cartridge's RTTI spelling". Only _ZTV10Scuttlebug escapes, because ov071/symbols.txt already carries the coined vtable alias at 0x02122c2c alongside _ZTV7daSpd_c -- the aliasing was done for vtables and not for _ZTI/_ZTS.

The unblocking operation is a class rename to daSpd_c, and tools/class_rename.py refuses it as-is: "REFUSING: _ZTV7daSpd_c is already defined in ['config/arm9/overlays/ov071/symbols.txt'] -- A class that already carries the ROM name needs the COINED ALIAS DELETED, not this rename." So the sequence is delete the coined _ZTV10Scuttlebug alias, then rename. That rewrites all 37 member symbols in symbols.txt, 11 shard filenames, delinks.txt paths, decl_common.h, converted-baseline.json and the naming ledgers -- a tree-wide naming change, deliberately NOT folded into this promotion. Its docstring says 125 classes sit in the same state.

Faking the two rows with a symbols.txt alias at the daSpd_c addresses would pass verify and be WRONG: the emitted string is 13 bytes of "10Scuttlebug" against the cartridge's 12 bytes of "7daSpd_c", so the deferred romdata_check compare is a real mismatch. deadstrip-data's home check is a NAME lookup, not a byte compare, and it happens in rombuild, not here.

Genuine lifecycle source form: the real header defines the virtual destructor inline and this TU defines OnYoshiTryEat, the first non-inline virtual the class declares, as the key function. mwccarm then owns retail D1 (0x0211f000) then D0 (0x0211f048) plus the class vtable and RTTI, with no D2, no forcing scaffold and no hand-written metadata. Measured 37/37 MATCH first compile, objisolate clean, emission order ROM-ascending under DEFAULT codegen -- defer_codegen off was not needed and was not used.

daSpd_c_classInit and the SPIDER profile relationship are reconstructed source-style names (historical alias Scuttlebug_Spawn). The 0x3ac allocation size, the member construction order and the vtable identity are proven; the exact original SM64DS spelling is not. g_profile_SPIDER (0x02122c08) is data this TU does not claim and does not define.
